_note: W01's template kit, expressed as data (CODEX2 §2). The 22 template documents that PATH-MANIFEST.json assigns to W01 (docs/phase-2/_templates/*.md) were removed by the 2026-11-19 documentation purge. No surviving authoritative source enumerates their fields, so per CODEX2 §2 each template's content contract is recorded UNRESOLVED rather than invented — the names and one-line purposes below are derived from the manifest entries, not reconstructed from the deleted documents. `knownVersions` and `fieldTypes` are the vocabulary scripts/gates/gate-verify.ts validates registries against; `containment/VERIFY-FIXTURES.json` carries a valid and an invalid instance for every rule. gate-verify.ts asserts this registry mirrors the manifest's W01 template set exactly (no missing, no extra), that every entry has a recorded disposition, and that the validator accepts/rejects the fixtures deterministically.
